title: Uniform measured variable-deletion SAT from bounded obstruction lists
claims: ExactObstructionBudgetSAT gives exact canonical domain and SAT languages in P from a measured obstruction selector of fixed arity a and a polynomial bound on (2*a)^k.
MeasuredObstructionWalk verifies a single rank path in polynomial time and proves exact existential rank semantics on canonical pairs.
MeasuredHornObstruction extracts two positive variable occurrences that any successful Horn deletion must hit.
ExactHornObstructionBudgetSAT checks the exact Horn deletion guard and SAT language for polynomially bounded powers 4^k.
ObstructionBudgetSATSearch gives sparse witness recovery under the stated short-clause closure premise.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
